description: This file defines a thread-safe JSON storage management class providing methods to load, save, append, update, retrieve, and filter JSON data stored in files, with logging for operations.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: A class managing thread-safe operations over JSON files, including load, save, append, update, get_by_id, and filter functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self, cache_path: Path)
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a specified cache directory path.

methods.name: Path _get_file_path(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for a given filename, ensuring it has a .json extension.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] load(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Loads data from the specified JSON file, returning a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: bool save(self, filename: str, data: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Saves a list of dictionaries to the specified JSON file.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append(self, filename: str, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Appends a new item to the JSON file, automatically assigning an ID and timestamp.

methods.name: bool update(self, filename: str, item_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing item identified by its ID in the JSON file with new data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, filename: str, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its ID from the JSON file.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] filter(self, filename: str, **filters)
methods.description: Filters items in the JSON file based on provided key-value criteria.

ctags.name: append
ctags.pattern: /^    def append(self, filename: str, item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: filter

ctags.name: get_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_by_id(self, filename: str, item_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: load
ctags.pattern: /^    def load(self, filename: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def save(self, filename: str, data: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, filename: str, item_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:$/
